basics.name: Luis Manuel Brito
basics.label: IT Support Specialist with Over 7 Years of Comprehensive Experience in Information Technology
basics.summary: With over seven years of experience as an IT Support Specialist, I currently serve as an IT Specialist in Caracas, Venezuela. My expertise spans diverse environments, including retail technology and hospitality sectors. I have contributed to IT infrastructure projects, provided technical support, managed server administration, and developed tailored solutions using programming languages such as JavaScript and Python. Passionate about continuous learning and knowledge sharing, I am a proactive, detail-oriented professional with strong analytical skills and a proven ability to collaborate effectively in team settings.

work.name: MoDo Caracas

Manage and maintain backups for databases, virtual servers, and physical servers, ensuring data integrity and system reliability.
highlights: Designed and implemented server backup protocols, reducing data recovery time by 30%.
Led server configuration projects, enhancing system performance and uptime.

work.name: MoDo Caracas

work.name: World Tel-Fax Electronics

Delivered technical assistance to the Contact Center and administrative teams, resolving platform issues and escalating complex cases to system engineers when necessary, adhering to best practices.
highlights: Improved Contact Center platform stability, reducing ticket resolution time by 20%.
Enhanced data center monitoring processes, ensuring 99.9% uptime for critical services.
